mapper.select: SELECT 'RUN_SEGMENT' AS source_type,CAST(s.id AS varchar) AS source_id, s.task_code,s.produce_task_code,s.arrange_code,a.workshop_code,a.shift_code, s.device_code,CASE WHEN s.segment_type='RUN' THEN 'RUN' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS kind, s.start_time,s.end_time,s.status AS state, CASE WHEN s.close_reason='LEGACY_GAP' THEN FALSE WHEN s.sample_eligible=TRUE OR (s.status='CANCELLED' AND s.close_reason='CLOSE') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS eligible,COALESCE(s.exclusion_reason,s.close_reason) AS reason FROM mom_mes.mes_task_execution_segment s JOIN mom_mes.mes_task_arrange a ON a.id=s.arrange_id AND a.code=s.arrange_code AND a.task_code=s.task_code AND a.produce_task_code=s.produce_task_code AND a.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND a.factory_code=s.factory_code WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.factory_code=#{factory} AND s.del_flag='0' AND (s.start_time < #{q.endTime} OR s.start_time IS NULL) AND (s.end_time > #{q.startTime} OR s.end_time IS NULL OR s.end_time < s.start_time OR (s.end_time=s.start_time AND s.start_time >= #{q.startTime})) AND 1=0 AND ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'APPROVED_LABOR' AS source_type,CAST(l.id AS varchar) AS source_id, l.task_code,l.produce_task_code,l.arrange_code,a.workshop_code,a.shift_code, l.worker_code,'LABOR' AS kind,l.labor_start AS start_time,l.labor_end AS end_time, l.status AS state,TRUE AS eligible,l.reason FROM mom_mes.mes_labor_entry l JOIN mom_mes.mes_task_arrange a ON a.id=l.arrange_id AND a.code=l.arrange_code AND a.task_code=l.task_code AND a.produce_task_code=l.produce_task_code AND a.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND a.factory_code=l.factory_code WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND l.factory_code=#{factory} AND l.del_flag='0' AND l.status IN ('APPROVED','VOID_PENDING') AND l.labor_start < #{q.endTime} AND l.labor_end > #{q.startTime} AND 1=0 AND ORDER BY l.id LIMIT #{limit}

WITH transitions AS ( SELECT e.*,LEAD(e.event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY e.arrange_id ORDER BY e.event_version) AS next_time, LEAD(e.event_version) OVER (PARTITION BY e.arrange_id ORDER BY e.event_version) AS next_version, LEAD(e.previous_status) OVER (PARTITION BY e.arrange_id ORDER BY e.event_version) AS next_previous, LEAD(e.status) OVER (PARTITION BY e.arrange_id ORDER BY e.event_version) AS next_status, LEAD(e.proven) OVER (PARTITION BY e.arrange_id ORDER BY e.event_version) AS next_proven FROM mom_mes.mes_arrange_timing_event e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND e.factory_code=#{factory} AND e.del_flag='0' ) SELECT 'PAUSE_EVENT' AS source_type,CAST(e.id AS varchar) AS source_id, e.task_code,e.produce_task_code,e.arrange_code,a.workshop_code,a.shift_code, a.planned_device_code AS device_code,'PAUSE' AS kind,e.event_time AS start_time, e.next_time AS end_time,CASE WHEN e.next_time IS NULL THEN 'OPEN' ELSE 'CLOSED' END AS state, CASE WHEN e.proven=TRUE AND e.event_kind='STATE_CHANGE' AND e.previous_status='PRODUCT' AND ((e.next_time IS NULL AND a.status='PAUSE') OR (e.next_version=e.event_version+1 AND e.next_previous='PAUSE' AND e.next_status IN ('PRODUCT','FINISH','CLOSE') AND e.next_proven=TRUE)) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS eligible, COALESCE(s.close_reason,e.reason) AS reason FROM transitions e JOIN mom_mes.mes_task_arrange a ON a.id=e.arrange_id AND a.code=e.arrange_code AND a.task_code=e.task_code AND a.produce_task_code=e.produce_task_code AND a.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND a.factory_code=e.factory_code LEFT JOIN mom_mes.mes_task_execution_segment s ON s.id=e.segment_id AND s.arrange_id=e.arrange_id AND s.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND s.factory_code=e.factory_code AND s.del_flag='0' WHERE e.status='PAUSE' AND e.event_time < #{q.endTime} AND (e.next_time > #{q.startTime} OR e.next_time IS NULL OR e.next_time < e.event_time OR (e.next_time=e.event_time AND e.event_time >= #{q.startTime})) AND 1=0 AND ORDER BY e.id LIMIT #{limit}
